newsitem.title: IRAQ: Iraq says it uncovers spy ring working for Israel.
newsitem.headline: Iraq says it uncovers spy ring working for Israel.

text.p: Iraq said on Wednesday it had uncovered a spy ring working for the Israeli intelligence service and it would show the "traitors" on Iraqi television later in the evening.
"The Iraqi Intelligence Department has uncovered a spy network which works for the Zionist Mossad," the official Iraqi News Agency INA reported.
It said it would "publish confessions of the traitors as soon as they are shown on Iraqi television after 9.00 p.m. local time (1800 GMT)."
Last month Iraqi television showed four Iraqis it accused of spying for the U.S. Central Intelligence Agency, but in Washington a U.S. official called it a "propaganda ploy".
